description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Value Added Tax Act No. 14 of 2002
categorisation: This gazette content is a legal/regulatory notification that exercises powers under the Value Added Tax Act to prescribe specific services and conditions for tax purposes. It contains no government personnel changes or structural reorganizations, but rather establishes regulatory frameworks for information technology and enabled services under tax legislation. The content focuses entirely on legal provisions, conditions, and regulatory requirements rather than government administration or personnel matters.
